title: Multi-Agent Streamlit App
readme_snippet:
# Multi-Agent Streamlit App Setup Guide

This guide explains how to set up and run the Streamlit app with three agents (Swallow, React, and Deep Agent) with memory and MCP integration.

## Project Structure

```
.
├── streamlit_app.py           # Main Streamlit application
├── helper_agents.py           # Agent definitions
├── mcp_client.py              # MCP client for tools
├── mcp_config.yaml            # MCP server configuration
├── requirements.txt           # Python dependencies
├── Dockerfile                 # Docker container specification
├── docker-compose.yml         # Docker composition for multi-container setup
├── .dockerignore              # Files to ignore in Docker build
└── mcp_servers_hub/           # MCP server implementations
    └── mathserver.py          # Math MCP server
```

## Features

- **Three Agents**: Swallow, React, and Deep Agent in separate tabs
- **Memory Management**: Thread-based conversation history
- **MCP Integration**: Tools from Math server and Tavily search
- **Container Support**: Run in Docker with separate services
- **Persistent History**: Conversation tracked per thread ID

## Option 1: Local Development (No Docker)

### 1. Setup Environment

```bash
# Create and activate virtual environment
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate  # Windows
# or
source .venv/bin/activate  # macOS/Linux

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
